# Livia Bar & Grill

> > Modern Italian restaurant and bar in Flagler Village, Fort Lauderdale, offering gourmet dining with handcrafted pasta, wood-fired pizza, premium steaks, and craft cocktails.

Livia Bar & Grill is a contemporary Italian dining destination in Fort Lauderdale's Flagler Village neighborhood, featuring signature dishes with ingredients like Calabrian chili, Gorgonzola, and Wagyu beef. The restaurant offers dinner service, Sunday brunch with bottomless mimosas, happy hour specials, and ladies' night, with reservations available through Resy and OpenTable.

## Key Topics

- Modern Italian Cuisine
- Flagler Village Fort Lauderdale
- Wood-Fired Pizza
